reviews.snippet:
Mai 0 rating deta hu iska kuch reason hai
1 ultrasound karwana tha to mere papa ne 10 baje subah apna file jama kar diye to unhone kaha ki 2 bje hoga fir kaha ki 2.30 bje hoga fir 3 baj Gaya nahi huaa mere mere papa ne bola ki written me do ki nahi hoga fir unhone bolne ke bad ultrasound kiya uske bad har chij ke liye bahut waiting karna padta hai sabkuch free hota hai lekin medicine ka paisa lagta hai agar ayushman card se karwana hai to mat aao yaha kahi aur chale jao
2 ek baat aur mera phone unhone liya aur khud 5 rating kar diya ye mujhe galat laga kyuki agar achha lagega aapki service to ham khud denge lekin achha na ho to 5 star kyu de

extracted_snippet.translated:
There are a few reasons why I give it a 0 rating.
1. I needed an ultrasound, so my dad submitted my file at 10 am. They said it would be at 2 am, then said it would be at 2:30 pm, then it was 3 am. My dad said I'll write it down or not. Then they did the ultrasound after he said that. After that, you have to wait a long time for everything. Everything is free, but medicines cost money. If you want to get it done using your Ayushman card, don't come here; go somewhere else.
2. One more thing: they took my phone and gave me a 5 rating. I found this unfair because if If we like your service then we will give it ourselves but if it is not good then why give 5 stars

response.snippet: Hamare kisi staff dwara aapka phone lekar khud 5-star rating dena behad sharmnaak aur hamare asoolon ke bilkul khilaf hai. Patient ka feedback sirf unki apni marzi aur anubhav par aadharit hona chahiye. Hamari management is unethical harkat, ultrasound ki delays, aur Ayushman billing protocols ki sakhti se jaanch kar rahi hai aur is par turant action liya jayega. Hum apni transparency aur honesty banaye rakhne ke liye poori tarah committed hain, jaisa ki Patna ke Best Hospital in Patna se umeed ki jati hai.

Patient feedback should be based solely on their own discretion and experience.
